units: metres in Blender/glTF; UE 5.8 glTF import converts to centimetres (1 m = 100 UU)
axes: +X along the module run, interior/room side +Y, Z up; pivot at the module's own base (z = 0) on its left end

X14_ARCH_Wall_Window_300.placement: outer walls only; interior face on y=0 like the plain wall, extra thickness goes outward

pivots: PIVOT_X14_DoorHinge at (0.998, -0.16, 0.01); leaf children rotate about local Z, open into -Y (away from the room) up to 100°
sockets: SOCKET_X14_DoorSign (2.3, 0, 1.55) — plate hangs on the room face, latch side

X14_ARCH_Corner.placement: at each inside corner point, rotated to fill the outside notch; wall trims form the inside mitre automatically

X14_ARCH_Floor_300.placement: grid at z = 0 (geometry is −0.05..0 in the mesh and offset +0.05 so the walking surface is z = 0)

sockets: SOCKET_X14_Pendant (1.5,1.5,0) rotated 180° about X — hang the pendant with its canopy here

X14_ARCH_Pendant_Lamp.placement: at SOCKET_X14_Pendant; module geometry has the bowl at z=0..0.2 and the canopy at z=1.1, so place at ceiling z − 1.10 unrotated

X14_PART_Panel_Solid_060.note: filler so runs can hit 0.3 m increments

X14_PART_Post.placement: centred on every panel joint, corner and run end; panels butt at the post centre line

X14_PART_DropCeiling_120.placement: grid at z = 2.75 (DROP_Z); hanger wires reach 0.5 m above

X14_PART_Fluorescent_120.placement: fixture base at DROP_Z − 0.62 (chains reach the grid underside)

states.unlit: swap the Tubes object material to MI_X14_Glass_Clear or set emissive 0 — no separate mesh needed

X14_PART_Sign_Door.placement: at SOCKET_X14_DoorSign, plate on y=0 facing +Y

INTEGRATION sockets: SOCKET_X15_StaffAccess_Door — the room's corridor door for X15 staff/back-of-house routing

X14_PART_Panel_Wood_090.note: 60 mm end posts included; panels butt post-to-post, no separate joint post needed

X14_ARCH_Torchere_Lamp.placement: free-standing on the floor; opal bowl emissive 1.5

X14_ARCH_Wall_Sconce.placement: pivot at the bottom of the backplate on the wall face (y=0), arm into the room (+Y); mount at z ≈ 2.32 m

X14_ARCH_Ceiling_Coffered_300.placement: z = ROOM_H − 0.30 (pivot on the beam underside; coffer soffits at ROOM_H)

demo_assembly.room: 9 × 6 × 4.6 m, windows on +X (east), door on −Y (south), 3 cubicles behind a 1.8 m corridor
demo_assembly.layout_status: FICTIONALISED (plausible per E4/E12/E18; not a documented 1963 plan)

collision: UCX_<module>_NN convex boxes per module; door leaves have their own UCX in the closed pose

lods.note_v002: wood partitions: LOD0 beads, LOD1 rails + panels, LOD2 same (already low); coffered ceiling: LOD0 rosettes + coves, LOD1 coves, LOD2 beams + panels only

pcg_rules: walls snap WallNext→WallPrev in 3.0 m steps
partitions snap PartNext→PartPrev in 1.2/0.9/0.6 m steps with a Post at each joint
drop-ceiling grid is independent of the 3 m architectural grid (1.2 m) and may stop short of walls by up to 0.6 m (1960s practice: perimeter soffit filler not modelled — see uncertainties)

demo_assembly_1953.room: same 9 × 6 × 4.6 m shell; wood partitions, coffered ceilings, 6 pendants, 3 torchères, 3 sconces, linoleum
